name: Saucer
summary: Hold to delete a cloud file: a flying saucer beams it up and zips away, Undo drops it back down
about: Saucer turns deleting a file into a tiny abduction. Hold the button for a second to confirm and the saucer charges its lights, glides over the file, opens a tractor beam and lifts it up, then stretches and zips off the screen while the other files close the gap and the storage meter drops. Undo brings the saucer back to lower the file gently onto the ground with a puff of dust.
how: Tap a file on the ground to aim the saucer at it.
Press and hold Hold to beam away for one second (Space or Enter works too).
Let go early to cancel; the ring shows how long is left.
Press Undo (or Ctrl+Z) within six seconds to bring the file back.
